scope: Static ROM, generated adapter and C++ review of all seven boss families (79 kinds); no game, tests or CPU/GPU execution
findings: All 79 boss kinds enter the existing discrete CommandScope, which consumes whole-period model flags and time; the missing city-NPC path does not apply.
Resident SDK time getter enters startup_runtime dora3_trace model_read even in Release, before loading time. Command read shadows are restored only for matching lifetime/run/time-command.
All direct boss object end-query sites retain matching original ROM hashes and terminal/continue presentation policy.
Equality cues use Source equality inside CommandScope, not fractional crossing that could invent extra attacks. Continuous pose paths are attachment-only and preserve command gates.
Bind, seek, pause/clamp and channel release invalidate run/event/terminal pose state. Rational model clock retains reverse-rate boundary handling and rate-change rebasing.
No additional confirmed boss defect found in the inspected paths; this is not complete gameplay verification.
